application.backend: Windows ARM64 native GPU completion timing

limitations: Single live trial per workload; host load, power, thermal state, caches and order uncontrolled.
Broad Start bracket contains23.077s input; shader bracket contains20s delivery measurement plus control/static time.
GPU records overlap and omit queues/readback. No hardware utilization or critical-path inference.
All final partial batches retained after normal shutdown; owned stderr below2MiB, no stop marker or malformed timing line.
No profiling-overhead isolation or live FPS gain claim. Signed driver still60Hz.

method.outlierPolicy: all observations retained; no outlier removal
method.backgroundWorkload: Interactive development host; no build or screen observer during live20s scopes. Explicit bounded GPU hook active in47 only.

metrics.name: all_gpuSpanNS
metrics.definition: One trial median of known durations in whole reports within the broad bracket. Every raw duration retained in configuration. Brackets include control/static time, not exact20s or animation attribution. Unknown counts separate, never zero. GPU spans may overlap/include waits and omit queues.
